name: change-highlight
title: Change Highlight
description: Flashes a change once (at most once a second, skipped under reduced motion), keeps a ▲/▼ with good/bad colour and the previous value in a tooltip, and can tell returning visitors what changed since their last visit.

meta.summary: Flashes a live price, count or status once when it changes and keeps an up/down marker, so updates aren't missed.
catches: Silent live updates to numbers and statuses
Whether a move is good or bad, given the direction you mark as good
Changes since the last visit, when storageKey is set
limits: "Since your last visit" is stored in this browser's localStorage, so it doesn't follow the user across devices
Screen readers hear changes only when announce is on
a11y: Flashes at most once a second and not at all with prefers-reduced-motion
Direction is given in words as well as ▲/▼ glyphs and colour
The changed value is focusable and described by a role="tooltip" showing the previous value
Optional aria-live="polite" announcement (announce prop); dismiss button has an aria-label

sources.label: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold

rules.note: Informational. One flash per second stays under the three-flashes-per-second limit.
